```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read in MRI data
```{r}
#read in CMR data
heart <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Cleaned Data/cardiac_i2.csv")) %>% na.omit()
#read in MRI data
brain <- read.csv(paste0(wd + "URIP 2024/UKB Cleaned Data/mri_data.csv")) %>% na.omit()
```

## Run PCA on heart MRI data
```{r}
#standardize CMR data and remove rows with missing values
heart_std <- heart %>% 
  select(-eid) %>% 
  scale(.)

#calculate heart principal components
heart_pc <- princomp(heart_std)
summary(heart_pc)

#visualize scree plot
plot(heart_pc)

#top 3 PCs are of interest


#see major contributors to PC1
sort(heart_pc$loadings[,1], decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
#primarily reflects LV radial strain & ejection fraction, RV ejection fraction

#major contributors to PC2
sort(heart_pc$loadings[,2], decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
#primarily reflects LV circumferential and longitudinal strain

#major contributors to PC 3
sort(heart_pc$loadings[,3], decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
#primarily reflects aortic and ventricular volumes

#save scores for first 3 PCs
heart_reduced <- heart_pc$scores[,1:3]
heart_reduced <- cbind(heart$eid, as.data.frame(heart_reduced))
colnames(heart_reduced) <- c('eid', 'heartPC1', 'heartPC2', 'heartPC3')
```

## Run PCA on brain MRI data
```{r}
#standardize CMR data and remove rows with missing values
brain_std <- brain %>% 
  select(-eid) %>% 
  scale(.)

#calculate heart principal components
brain_pc <- princomp(brain_std)
summary(brain_pc)

#visualize scree plot
plot(brain_pc)

#top 4 PCs are of interest


#see major contributors to PC1
sort(brain_pc$loadings[,1], decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
#reflects overall brain intensity in scan

#major contributors to PC2
sort(brain_pc$loadings[,2], decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
#primarily reflects fluid composition
#ventricles, choroid plexus


#major contributors to PC 3
sort(brain_pc$loadings[,3], decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
#primarily related to subcortical structures
#accumbens area, putamen, caudate, amygdala, hippocampus

#major contributors to PC 4
sort(brain_pc$loadings[,4], decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
#reflects defects in brain anatomy
#holes in segmentation (reflect brain anatomy abnormalities), WM hypointensities


#save scores for first 4 PCs
brain_reduced <- brain_pc$scores[,1:4]
brain_reduced <- cbind(brain$eid, as.data.frame(brain_reduced))
colnames(brain_reduced) <- c('eid', 'brainPC1', 'brainPC2', 'brainPC3', 'brainPC4')

```

## Fix names for MRI data
This does not need to be run again now that the names have been fixed on original data files
```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Add human‑readable field titles as column names
## ------------------------------------------------------------
add_field_titles <- function(
  filename,
  vars,                                        # character vector: names to relabel
  field_path = paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Cleaned Data/field_titles.csv")
) {
  library(stringr)  # for str_extract
  library(dplyr)    # for rename_with
  
  ## 1. Load data --------------------------------------------------------------
  df     <- read.csv(filename, check.names = FALSE)          # keep original names
  field  <- read.csv(field_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
              mutate(field_id = as.character(field_id))      # make sure it's character
  
  ## 2. Build a name‑mapping function -----------------------------------------
  vars_in_df <- intersect(vars, names(df))                   # ignore any vars not present
  
  # extract field‑ID from each column name and translate to title
  map_to_title <- function(colnames_vec) {
    sapply(colnames_vec, function(col) {
      if (!col %in% vars_in_df) return(col)                  # leave untouched
      
      # pull the part between “p” and “_”; if no “_”, take everything after “p”
      id <- str_extract(col, "(?<=p)([^_]+)")
      
      title <- field$title[match(id, field$field_id)]
      
      if (is.na(title) || title == "") col else title        # fallback to original if no match
    }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  }
  
  ## 3. Rename only the requested columns -------------------------------------
  df <- df %>% rename_with(map_to_title, .cols = all_of(vars_in_df))
  
  ## 4. Save over the original file -------------------------------------------
  write.csv(df, filename, row.names = FALSE)
  
  invisible(df)  # return the data frame for interactive use
}


add_field_titles(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Cleaned Data/cardiac_i2.csv"), names(heart))
add_field_titles(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Cleaned Data/mri_data.csv"), names(brain))
cognitive <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2025/Data/cognitive.csv"))
add_field_titles(paste0(wd, "URIP 2025/Data/cognitive.csv"), names(cognitive))
```

#Read in covariate data
```{r}
#load covariate data (this is pulled from 2 different source files)
#read in data for the majority of covariates
#this was originally extracted for odds ratio calculation
or_data1 <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Raw Data/or_data1.csv"))
or_data1 <- or_data1 %>% select(-X)
or_data2 <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Raw Data/or_data2.csv"))
or_data2 <- or_data2 %>% select(-X)
or_data3 <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Raw Data/or_data3.csv"))
or_data3 <- or_data3 %>% select(-X)
or_data4 <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Raw Data/or_data4.csv"))
or_data4 <- or_data4 %>% select(-X)
or_data5 <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Raw Data/or_data5.csv"))
or_data5 <- or_data5 %>% select(-X)

#join covariate dataframes
covar <- rbind(or_data1, or_data2, or_data3, or_data4, or_data5)
rm(list = c("or_data1", "or_data2", "or_data3", "or_data4", "or_data5"))

#read in covariates from instance 2
i2 <- read.csv("imaging_instance.csv") %>% 
  select(-X)

joined_covars <- i2 %>% 
  left_join(covar)
#rename and relabel variables for clarity
#clean dataframe
covar <- joined_covars %>% 
  #label covariates for better readability
  mutate(Age = p21003_i2,
         Sex = factor(p31, labels = c('Female', 'Male')),
         Education = p845_i0) %>% 
  mutate(BMI = p21001_i2) %>% 
  #Create readable smoking status levels
  mutate(Smoking = factor(p20116_i2, labels = c('Prefer not to answer', 'Never', 'Previous', 'Current'))) %>% 
  #Label all types of depression/bipolar as yes, no if otherwise
  mutate(Depression.Bipolar = factor(p20126_i0, labels = c('No', rep('Yes', 5)))) %>%
  #Extract parents's AD status
  mutate(Father.Alzheimers = ifelse(grepl('10', joined_covars$p20107_i2), TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  mutate(Mother.Alzheimers = ifelse(grepl('10', joined_covars$p20110_i2), TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  #Replace non response encodings from physical activity data with NA
  #This reflects the number of days of moderate physical activity each week
  mutate(Physical.Activity = replace(p884_i2, p884_i2 %in% c(-1, -3), NA)) %>% 
  #Label alcohol consumption levels
  mutate(Alcohol = factor(p1558_i2, labels = c('Daily or almost daily', '3-4 times a week', '1-2 times a week', '1-3 times a month', 'Special occasions only', 'Never', 'Prefer not to answer'))) %>% 
  #Label annual income levels
  mutate(Income = factor(p738_i2, labels = c('<£18,000', '£18,000-£30,999', '£31,000-£51,999', '£52,000-£100,000', '>£100,000', "Do not know", "Prefer not to answer"))) %>% 
  #Save diabetes status as factor
  mutate(Diabetes = factor(ifelse(grepl('E11', joined_covars$p41270), "Yes", "No"))) %>% 
  select(eid, Age, Sex, BMI, Smoking, Depression.Bipolar, Physical.Activity, Alcohol, Income, Education, Father.Alzheimers, Mother.Alzheimers, p21000_i0)
#Adjust ethnicity encodings to be more generalized
covar$Ethnicity <- as.character(covar$p21000_i0)
covar$Ethnicity <- ifelse(startsWith(covar$Ethnicity, '1'), 'White',
                                  ifelse(startsWith(covar$Ethnicity, '2'), 'Mixed',
                                         ifelse(startsWith(covar$Ethnicity, '3'), 'Asian',
                                                ifelse(startsWith(covar$Ethnicity, '4'), 'Black',
                                                       ifelse(covar$Ethnicity=='5', 'Chinese',
                                                              ifelse(covar$Ethnicity=='6', 'Other',
                                                                     NA))))))
#drop original ethnicity column
covar <- covar %>% select(-p21000_i0)
#categorize ethnic background as a factor variable
covar$Ethnicity<- factor(covar$Ethnicity)

#read in blood pressure information from other data file
bp <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Raw Data/covar_data.csv"))
#only retain blood pressure information
bp <- bp %>% select(eid, p4079_i2_a0, p4080_i2_a0, p30780_i0, p30760_i0) %>% 
  rename(SBP = p4080_i2_a0) %>% 
  rename(DBP = p4079_i2_a0) %>% 
  rename(LDL = p30780_i0) %>% 
  rename(HDL = p30760_i0)

#join both covariate dataframes
covar <- bp %>% left_join(covar)

#snp data (I need to figure out how I can extract this, pretty sure I can do it with PLINK on RAP)

#load AD/CVD diagnosis data
diagnosis <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2024/UKB Cleaned Data/or_clean.csv"))[,13:26]

#load cognitive testing results
cognitive <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2025/Data/cognitive.csv"))[,1:6]

#join all of them
joined_data <- heart_reduced %>% 
  left_join(brain_reduced) %>% 
  left_join(covar) %>% 
  left_join(diagnosis) %>%

```


## Data cleaning
```{r}
#list values that must be recoded as NA
na_levels <- c(NULL = "Do not know", NULL = "Prefer not to answer")

joined_data_clean  <- joined_data %>% 
  #replace NA depression variables with "No"
  mutate(Depression.Bipolar = fct_na_value_to_level(Depression.Bipolar, level = "No")) %>%
  #remove participants with greater than 10% missingness
  filter( rowMeans(is.na(.)) <= 0.20) %>% 
  #recode non-response values for factors as NA
  mutate(across(
    where(is.factor),
    ~ fct_recode(., !!!na_levels)))

#reclassify income to middle of each category
#i believe this is the best way to numerically reflect the values
income_map <- c("<£18,000" = 9000, "£18,000-£30,999" = 24500, "£31,000-£51,999" = 41500, "£52,000-£100,000" = 76000, ">£100,000" = 100000)
joined_data_clean$Income <- income_map[joined_data_clean$Income]

#reclassify alcohol consumption as approximate number of drinks per year
alcohol_map = c('Daily or almost daily' = 365, '3-4 times a week' = 182, '1-2 times a week' = 78, '1-3 times a month' = 24, 'Special occasions only' = 12)
joined_data_clean$Alcohol <- alcohol_map[joined_data_clean$Alcohol]

#one-hot encode indicator variables
library(fastDummies)
joined_data_hot <- dummy_cols(joined_data_clean, 
                              remove_most_frequent_dummy = TRUE, 
                              ignore_na = TRUE) %>% 
  #remove previous categorical variables
  select(-Sex, -Smoking, -Depression.Bipolar, -Ethnicity, -eid)

#normalize data
joined_data_scaled <- scale(joined_data_hot)

#save center and scaling factors
mu <- attr(joined_data_scaled, "scaled:center")
sigma <- attr(joined_data_scaled, "scaled:scale")

#convert scaled data matrix to dataframe
joined_data_scaled <- as.data.frame(joined_data_scaled)
write.csv(joined_data_hot, "clean_no_imp.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
##Impute missing data
```{r}
#run KNN on continuous variables
library(VIM)
imputed_data <- kNN(joined_data_scaled)
```

## Remove unnecessary columns and create cognitive PC
```{r}


#descale data
imputed_descaled <- sweep(imputed_data, 2, sigma, "*")
imputed_descaled <- sweep(imputed_descaled, 2, mu, "+")

#remove imputation indicators
imputed_clean <- imputed_descaled[1:46] %>% 
  cbind(eid = joined_data_clean$eid, .)

#extract cognitive test results
cognitive_imp <- imputed_clean %>% 
  select(Mean.time.to.correctly.identify.matches, Maximum.digits.remembered.correctly, 
         Fluid.intelligence.score, Duration.to.complete.alphanumeric.path..trail..2., 
         Number.of.puzzles.correctly.solved) %>% 
  mutate(Mean.time.to.correctly.identify.matches = -Mean.time.to.correctly.identify.matches,
         Duration.to.complete.alphanumeric.path..trail..2. = -Duration.to.complete.alphanumeric.path..trail..2.) %>% scale(.)

#perform PCA
cognitive_pc <- princomp(cognitive_imp)
summary(cognitive_pc)
plot(cognitive_pc)
#will only retain the first principal component for initial analyses

cognitive_pc$loadings
imputed_clean$cognitivePC1 <- cognitive_pc$scores[,1]

#add cognitive PC to dataframe, remove original cognitive variables
imputed_clean <- imputed_clean %>% 
  select(-c(Mean.time.to.correctly.identify.matches, Maximum.digits.remembered.correctly, 
         Fluid.intelligence.score, Duration.to.complete.alphanumeric.path..trail..2., 
         Number.of.puzzles.correctly.solved))

#save results for clustering analysis
write.csv(imputed_clean, "imputed_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Prepare prescription information
```{r}
library(data.table)
#read in file of prescription codes
prescrip_codes <- fread(paste0(wd, "URIP 2025/Data/coding4.tsv"))

#read in ukb prescription data
prescrip_data <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "URIP 2025/Data/prescrip.csv"))

#save list of codes of interest
cvd_drugs <- list(
  statins = c('simvastatin', 'rosuvastatin', 'atorvastatin', 'pravastatin', 'fluvastatin'),
  diuretics = c("chlorothiazide", "chlorthalidone", "polythiazide", "indapamide", "metolazone", "bumetanide", "furosemide", "amiloride", "triamterene"), 
  beta_blockers = c("acebutolol", "betaxolol", "bisoprolol", "metoprolol", "nadolol", 
                   "propranolol", "timolol", "atenolol", "penbutolol", "pindolol", 
                   "carvedilol", "labetalol"),
  angiotensin_antagonists = c("candesartan", "eprosartan", "irbesartan", "losartan", "olmesartan", "telmisartan", "valsartan"),
  calcium_channel_blockers = c("diltiazem", "verapamil", "amlodipine", "felodipine", "isradipine", "nicardipine", "nisoldipine"),
  anticoagulants = c("heparin", "warfarin")
)

#inialize list for numeric codes
cvd_drugs_codes <- vector(mode = "list", length = 6)
names(cvd_drugs_codes) <- names(cvd_drugs)

#iterate through list converting to numeric codes
for(i in 1:length(cvd_drugs)){
  cvd_drugs_codes[[i]] <- prescrip_codes$coding[prescrip_codes$meaning %in% cvd_drugs[[i]]]
}

#create indicator variables for each disease
prescrip_data <- cbind(prescrip_data,
      statins = logical(nrow(prescrip_data)), 
      diuretics = logical(nrow(prescrip_data)), 
      beta_blockers = logical(nrow(prescrip_data)),
      angiotensin_antagonists = logical(nrow(prescrip_data)),
      calcium_channel_blockers = logical(nrow(prescrip_data)),
      anticoagulants = logical(nrow(prescrip_data)))

#iterate through diseases and change to true if it contains one of the codes
for (i in seq_along(cvd_drugs_codes)) {                # i = 1…6
  prescrip_data[[49 + i]] <-
    rowSums(                                            # now a matrix
      sapply(prescrip_data[ , 2:49],                    # every column
             \(col) col %in% cvd_drugs_codes[[i]]),     # test membership
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) > 0
}

#filter to only relevant prescription data
prescrip_data <- prescrip_data %>% 
  select(eid, names(cvd_drugs_codes))
```


## Join prescription data with other variables for analysis
```{r}
#merge data frames
final_data <- imputed_clean %>% 
  left_join(prescrip_data) %>% 
  mutate(CVD = if_any(Hypertension:Cerebral.Infarction, ~ . > 0.00001)) %>% 
  filter(Age >= 60)


#save final dataframe for clustering as csv
write.csv(final_data, "clustering_data_parents_ad.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
